meta.name: wcag-audit-patterns
meta.description: Conduct WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits with automated testing, manual verification, and remediation guidance. Use when auditing websites for accessibility, fixing WCAG violations, or implementing accessible design patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计网站无障碍并给出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站需要满足 WCAG 无障碍标准且不确定从何入手。
copy.tagline_en: Audit website accessibility and get fix guidance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your website accessible to people with disabilities and meet WCAG standards.

howto.what: 装上本技能后,Claude 会进行 WCAG 2.2 无障碍审计:先自动检查,再人工核对,并给出修复建议;也会解释 A/AA/AAA 一致性等级、POUR 原则以及常见违规的影响分级。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计网站是否符合 WCAG 2.2、修复已发现的 WCAG 违规,或实现无障碍设计模式时,该技能会进入工作。

say.text: 这个页面有哪些不符合 WCAG 2.2 A/AA 的地方?
say.note: Claude 会先自动检测,再人工验证。

say.text: 这段表单缺少标签,帮我按 WCAG 修复。
say.note: Claude 会定位问题并给出改法。

say.text: 做一个无障碍的自定义下拉菜单。
say.note: Claude 会依照 WCAG 模式给出实现建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can audit websites against WCAG 2.2 with automated checks, manual verification, and fix suggestions. It also explains conformance levels A/AA/AAA, POUR principles, and how common violations are ranked by impact.
howto.when_en: It starts when a user asks to audit a website for WCAG 2.2 accessibility, fix WCAG violations, or implement an accessible design pattern.

say_en.text: What parts of this page don't meet WCAG 2.2 A/AA?
say_en.note: Claude runs automated checks, then manually verifies.

say_en.text: This form is missing labels; fix it to follow WCAG.
say_en.note: Claude pinpoints problems and proposes corrections.

say_en.text: Build an accessible custom dropdown menu.
say_en.note: Claude suggests an implementation following WCAG patterns.
